summary: The minor is at least 20 units of Electrical Engineering lecture courses at the 200 level or above; courses outside EE count only from the five depth-area lists. Seminars and independent study do not count, at most 5 of the 20 units may be taken without a letter grade, and you need a 3.35 GPA in these courses, which your advisor checks. You also take one course from each of the five depth-area lists, as the Bulletin lists them.
